g.text: 4 | Cost and completion for each episode
Each point is one saved run; nearby numbers identify run 1–5
Higher completion at lower cost appears toward the upper left; tasks are compared in separate panels.
Costs are recorded public-rate estimates using actual cache usage. Task 4: retained run set.
